name: mcpperm
description: Local-first MCP manifest permission profiler and policy generator.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js inspect fixtures/filesystem-server.json && node -e "const {mkdtempSync}=require('node:fs'); const {tmpdir}=require('node:os'); const {join,resolve}=require('node:path'); const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process'); const cwd=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'mcpperm-smoke-')); const cli=resolve('dist/src/cli.js'); const oldPolicy=join(cwd,'old.json'); const newPolicy=join(cwd,'new.json'); execFileSync(process.execPath,[cli,'policy',resolve('fixtures/docs-server.json'),'--output',oldPolicy],{stdio:'inherit'}); execFileSync(process.execPath,[cli,'policy',resolve('fixtures/messaging-server.json'),'--output',newPolicy],{stdio:'inherit'}); execFileSync(process.execPath,[cli,'diff',oldPolicy,newPolicy,'--json'],{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
